Name: Hosted workspace
Desc: A hosted workspace for one tenant: mail (Postfix transport, Dovecot mailboxes over IMAP) and chat (Mattermost on CloudNativePG PostgreSQL). Users in three regions reach both services through the edge-gw gateway fleet; a traffic manager probes the units and steers each region's mail-<region> and chat-<region> Services. An independent alternate gateway, edge-alt, can carry services placed on it. Operational history is in the operations-log ConfigMap.
Supported Operations: Read and send mail over IMAP and SMTP
Inspect gateway, traffic manager and mail queue state
Inspect application logs and Prometheus metrics
